messages:
Elaine: Quick sync — Acme Health wants to close this week. They pushed back on our MSA liability cap and asked to add an appendix for EU data residency. They also sent an Order Form that expects PO + DocuSign flow. Link: https://drive.redwood/acme/msadpa-v3.pdf
Tom (legal): Got it. Can you DM the redline they returned? If it's just liability cap + residency we can probably accept with exec signoff.
Elaine: Dropped vendor redline here -> https://drive.redwood/acme/vendor-redline-2026.pdf. Their proposed liability cap = $5M, they want 12 month lookback for breaches, and add subprocessors clause to allow vendor-side analytics.
Tom (legal): Thanks. Short answers: 1) $5M is high — we should counter to $1M / 12 months for SaaS. 2) 12-month lookback is ok if limited to demonstrable incidents. 3) subprocessors: ask for clause that requires notice + right to object. I'll draft a one-page markup.
Maria (finance): On PO: they need net30 and a PO number on the Order Form. We can do net30 but need the signed Order Form + PO to create invoice. Who will generate the PO on their side?
Elaine: Vendor contact says procurement will issue a PO after MSA signed. They want us to send DocuSign envelope with the Order Form + MSA bundled so they can sign both.
Ben (eng): Small note — POC used our Dedicated cluster; we need to confirm billing for the trial GPUs in the Order Form (they used reserved dev capacity). If finance needs line items I can export usage.
Ryan-ops: If the Order Form includes private deployment options (VPC/on-prem) ensure the DPA references KMS/HSM controls we require. I can attach standard ops language.
Tom (legal): I uploaded a redline with suggested counters and a short fallback clause for residency. legal-bot: https://drive.redwood/acme/msadpa-tom-redline.pdf :thumbsup:
Elaine: Thx. Two asks for the team: 1) Tom — can you approve a counter with $1M cap + objection window on subprocessors? 2) Maria — we need the Order Form template with line items and billing terms (net30). 3) Who sends the envelope?
Tom (legal): Yes to the counter. Approve sending with a cover note — call out that price and PO flow unchanged. I'll add an exec approval placeholder for signature on page 2.
Maria (finance): I'll prepare the Order Form with line items and attach our billing contact. I need the usage export from Ben (eng) by EOD.
Ben (eng): Exported usage CSV here: `s3://redwood-acme/poc-usage/2026-03-18.csv`. (small) Will DM credentials.
Elaine: OK I'll bundle MSA + DPA + Order Form into DocuSign. Who should be the envelope sender from Redwood? Tom (legal) or Maria (finance)?
Tom (legal): Maria should be sender for billing alignment. I'll be CC'd as reviewer. Make sure envelope has sign order: vendor -> exec -> Redwood finance -> Redwood legal (final).
Ryan-ops: Add a checkbox for 'Private deployment addendum' so vendor signs that page if relevant.
Elaine: Noted. Sending plan: Maria will create Order Form, Ben provides usage line items, Tom finalizes redline, I assemble and send DocuSign with the sign order Tom suggested. Vendor expected to countersign within 48h.
Maria (finance): I'll create the Order Form and set envelope sender to finance@redwood.com. ETA 3pm PT.
Tom (legal): I'll review the envelope pre-send. If they countersign any new redline items we escalate to exec.
Elaine: Great — tagging @ryan-ops for the addendum text. If everyone is good I'll send the assembled envelope once Maria uploads the Order Form. :rocket:
Ryan-ops: Sending the standard private-deploy addendum now: https://drive.redwood/ops/private-addendum-2026.txt
Elaine: Appreciate it. I'll post final send confirmation in this thread and ping procurement if they don't have a PO after 48h.
Maria (finance): Order Form uploaded and envelope ready to go — waiting on Tom's final review.
Tom (legal): Reviewed. Minor tweak to subprocessors clause — updated in the envelope. Good to send.
Elaine: Sent DocuSign envelope to vendor (envelope id: 0a1b2c3d). Vendor notification shows delivered. Will follow up if not countersigned in 48h. :white_check_mark:
legal-bot: DocuSign status update — envelope 0a1b2c3d delivered to vendor at 2026-04-18T16:04:12Z
Elaine: Closing note — if vendor requests different signature flow (exec first) escalate to me and Tom. Otherwise tracking PO and invoice after countersign. Thanks team. :pray:
